{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Sarpentia''''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the navy of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Makin]]. The ''Sarpentia'' participated in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]].
